boundary_manifest.coordinates: Same unshifted right-handed Cartesian x/y/z as volume/flow; no anatomical axis labels assigned
boundary_manifest.flux_sign: integral(u dot n_out dA): INLET negative; OUTLET positive; Qin = -inlet_signed_flux

WALL.normal_definition: n_out = cross(x1-x0,x2-x0)/norm(cross); verified against owning tetra centroid
WALL.note: Use per-triangle outward normals; mean is not a replacement for local wall normals.
